message: Shell command built from environment values still reported at generic verify dispatcher after scripts moved to files.
cause: Generic dispatch mixed shell and tool execution; CodeQL merged environment-derived command/path arguments across call sites.
correction: Separate dedicated shell execution from ordinary tools. Constant source "$1" shell text receives a quoted positional path and closed child stdin. No environment/path interpolation into shell program text.
additionalDiagnosis: Passing script bodies through stdin avoided the query but a child cat consumed later script text and returned empty stdout. Added regression preserving closed child stdin, plus timeout, hostile values, exclusive scripts and nonzero-status checks.
localQualification: Prior exact-tree full pass for b743 retained separately; changed dispatcher requires fresh final gate and fresh hosted CodeQL.
reviewer: User deferred a separate reviewer until requested.
